product_metadata.title: Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick Aluminum 12-Inch Skillet, Black
features: The skillet's heavy duty construction promotes quick and even heating to reduce hotspots that can burn food
The durable, top-quality nonstick interior provides easy food release and cleanup; skillet is dishwasher safe for added convenience.
The skillet's strong, comfortable handle provides a confident grip
This dishwasher safe nonstick skillet is oven safe to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
description: Farberware has built its reputation providing cooks with high-quality pots and pans since 1900, and this Farberware Dishwasher Safe Nonstick Aluminum 12-Inch Skillet combines that legacy with modern features that make it a great choice for today. Constructed from heavy-duty aluminum, the skillet heats quickly and evenly for cooking delicious meals in a snap, reducing hot spots that can burn food. Long-lasting, top-quality nonstick coats the skillet’s interior for excellent food release, whether toasting a gooey grilled cheese sandwich or sautéing a vegetable medley. For added convenience, the nonstick skillet is dishwasher safe and its sleek exterior is also easy to clean, while bringing a touch of style to any kitchen decor. The aluminum skillet is oven safe to 350°F and the strong, comfortable handle provides a confident grasp so cooks can sear a thick pork chop on the stovetop and transfer the pan into the oven for finishing. This Farberware Dishwasher Safe Aluminum Nonstick 12-Inch Skillet is a versatile pan busy cooks will reach for morning, noon and night.
